[[File:EliteDarktrooper-SWGTCGAoD.jpg|thumb|right|280px|An elite dark trooper]]

'''Elite dark troopers''' were a variant of [[Dark Trooper/Legends|dark troopers]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. With a more exaggerated helmet and far more advanced programming than standard dark troopers, these advanced battle droids were meant to serve as "super soldiers". They carried [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]], [[SE-14 blaster pistol|SE-14c]] pistols, fragmentation grenades, [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]], and [[Concussion grenade/Legends|concussion grenades]]. They, like all dark troopers, proved to be very effective in battle. Unlike [[Phase I Dark Trooper|Phase I dark troopers]], these soldiers saw many more battles and were more experienced. The early elite dark troopers were cyborg clones, but were changed to droids.<ref name="BF">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''</ref>
